sources.researchNote: The BnF catalogue supplies [1934] as the issue date, reconstructed from Répertoire phonographique, 3e supplément, 1934. This is a catalogue-supported issue year, not a recording-session date or a date transcribed from the label. The record therefore retains the bracketed display while distinguishing the basis of the dating.

sources.researchNote: The collection description associates this file with Columbia DF 1610; 1934 appears in the file name and collection disc list. The uploader does not distinguish the recording year from the issue year or supply a recording-session date, so 1934 is retained as a reported year for the described recording, not a confirmed session date. BnF independently catalogues the disc and supplies [1934] as its issue year, not its recording-session date. The Internet Archive file is used as the external access copy.
